$comment: Plain-English definitions for every term used anywhere in this section. Rendered by rushroyale.js on glossary.html with shape 'terms'. One sentence each — if a term needs a paragraph it belongs on a page, and the 'see' link should point there. Keep entries alphabetical by name; the renderer preserves file order. Fields: name, def, see {text, href}, tags. Terms describing the current build (Reincarnation, Synergized unit, Celestial Shards, Ability points, Profile perk, Relic, Essence, Archetype, Chapter, Floor, Endless floor, Dungeon modifier, Treasure Map) come from the game's in-game Knowledge Base, recorded 2026-08-27. Terms added later from the official patch-note archive (Bells, Clan War, Death Wave, Division, Faction blessing, Multifaction, Novelty bonus, Pantheon) describe structure the notes state plainly; they carry no figures that were not stated there, and none has been checked in-game.

entries.name: Ability points
entries.def: Issued for levelling up your hero, and spent to enhance that hero's abilities. They replaced the old craftable hero equipment.

entries.name: Archetype
entries.def: The category an ability falls into — Damage, Economy, Monsters, Negatives, Empowerment or Defense — which tells you what kind of effect it has.

entries.name: Arena
entries.def: The bracket your PvP rating puts you in; climbing arenas introduces new enemy types, such as the Virus boss from arena 7 and the Assassin from arena 9.

entries.name: Artifact
entries.def: An ability you equip to a deck, unlocked by gaining Legendarity. You can take up to three into a battle.

entries.name: Ascension
entries.def: A unit development step beyond levelling; a unit must reach the 4th Ascension, as well as level 15, before Reincarnation unlocks.

entries.name: Bedlam
entries.def: One of the named bosses — the example most often used when explaining that a boss arrives with health equal to the damage your opponent dealt to their Phantom.

entries.name: Bells
entries.def: The currency for Legendary Summoning — 45 for a standard summon, 75 for a Guest Star.

entries.name: Board
entries.def: The 3×5 grid of tiles you place units on — fifteen tiles, and no more, which is why merging exists.

entries.name: Bonus Orb
entries.def: A magic orb earned by levelling event legendaries, reserved for other units of that faction. It is spent before ordinary orbs and does not work for Reincarnation.

entries.name: Boss
entries.def: A heavy enemy that spawns on your board with health converted from the damage your opponent dealt to their Phantom. How much of their damage carries over grows with the wave number, so bosses get sharply more dangerous as a match runs on.

entries.name: Carry
entries.def: The single damage unit a deck is built around; the other four cards exist to raise its damage and attack speed — in PvP so it hits the Phantom as hard as possible, in co-op so nothing survives the wave.

entries.name: Celestial Shards
entries.def: An extremely rare material found where the celestial rifts have been, spent to give Reincarnated units new abilities.

entries.name: Chapter
entries.def: One dungeon in co-op. Each chapter contains several floors, and chapters are completed in a specific order.

entries.name: Clan
entries.def: A group of players who chat, request cards from each other, and enter clan-only content together.

entries.name: Clan War
entries.def: The clan event: daily clan quests pay Glory Points, which lift the clan’s balloon towards a treasure key. It replaced the four-phase Clan Tournament in 2025.

entries.name: Co-op
entries.def: Two players clearing AI waves together through a dungeon's floors, sharing a single gate and with no Phantom: one monster reaching that gate ends the run outright, with no hearts to absorb it.

entries.name: Crowd control
entries.def: Anything that slows, stuns or otherwise delays enemies instead of damaging them — buying your damage dealers time.

entries.name: Death Wave
entries.def: A phase where the monster and boss phases merge, bosses arrive every 30 seconds, and enemies gain escalating armour — designed to stop matches running long.

entries.name: Deck
entries.def: The five cards you bring to a match; every unit you summon is drawn at random from these five.

entries.name: Division
entries.def: A bracket set by your account’s progression rather than your rating; a higher division pays better seasonal rewards and opens more expedition portals.

entries.name: Dragon Rift
entries.def: Clan PvE across a series of worlds, where members' cumulative wins wear down a dragon's health until the clan can move on.

entries.name: Duel
entries.def: A PvP match against the closest opponent by actual power rather than by rating, offered automatically to players past 1,500 legendarity or 6,000 trophies.

entries.name: Dungeon modifier
entries.def: A season-long modifier that becomes active in co-op after the 5th floor. Individual floors carry their own negative modifiers on top of it.

entries.name: Endless floor
entries.def: The final floor of a co-op dungeon, with no defined waves. Its reward depends on how long you survive — 8 minutes pays 1650 gold.

entries.name: Essence
entries.def: The material that upgrades artifacts. The upgrade lands on a random unlocked artifact rather than one you choose.

entries.name: Expedition
entries.def: A passive, always-running source of hero fragments that can turn up legendary heroes for gold.

entries.name: Experiment Coins
entries.def: A narrow currency from the premium season pass, spent in its own shop section.

entries.name: Faction
entries.def: A grouping every unit belongs to — Dark Domain, Forest Alliance, Kingdom of Light, Magic Council and Technogenic Society are documented so far. Weekly faction blessings apply to one faction only, so a deck concentrated in one gets more from them.

entries.name: Faction blessing
entries.def: A weekly bonus given to two factions at a time, paying extra rewards for killing bosses with units of those factions.

entries.name: Fast Start
entries.def: A Season 74 experiment letting players who reached 8,000 trophies the previous season begin the next at 7,000, given enough legendarity and critical damage.

entries.name: Floor
entries.def: A battlefield within a co-op dungeon, where you defeat several bosses and the waves of monsters ahead of them. Cleared floors can be replayed.

entries.name: Fragments
entries.def: Per-thing material. Hero fragments unlock and level heroes; perk fragments develop profile perks alongside gold. Item fragments no longer exist, because heroes no longer take craftable equipment.

entries.name: Gate
entries.def: The point an enemy reaches if the board fails to kill it. In PvP you have your own and a leak costs hearts; in co-op the two players share one gate and a single leak ends the game.

entries.name: Gems
entries.def: The premium currency, also called crystals; earnable for free through achievements, quests and ads, or buyable.

entries.name: Gold
entries.def: The everyday currency, spent on card levels, chests, equipment and hero levels.

entries.name: Heart
entries.def: Your health in a PvP match — co-op has none. You start with 3: an ordinary monster reaching the gate costs 1 and a boss costs 2, so three common leaks or two boss leaks end the match.

entries.name: Legendarity
entries.def: A stat received for upgrading legendary units and heroes. High values show your status and unlock access to spells, artifacts and profile components — the higher it is, the more choices you have.

entries.name: Magic Dust
entries.def: An uncapped material you bank up and trade in at the store — 1,000 dust for one random legendary card.

entries.name: Magic Orbs
entries.def: The upgrade material every legendary level needs alongside duplicate cards — the real reason legendaries level slowly.

entries.name: Mana
entries.def: What you spend to summon units and to upgrade them mid-match; you start a match with 100 and earn more by killing things.

entries.name: Mana Power-up
entries.def: A per-unit ability you spend mana to trigger mid-match, separate from summoning and merging; what it does depends entirely on the unit, and some units replace it with something else entirely.

entries.name: Merge
entries.def: Combining two identical units of the same rank into one unit of the next rank, drawn at random from your deck — it frees a tile but gives up a body.

entries.name: Merge rank
entries.def: A unit's rank on the board, raised by merging and reset at the end of a match. Some units manipulate it directly — Banshee spends her own to feed other Banshees, and Blazey burns other units down to reduce theirs.

entries.name: Mini boss
entries.def: An enemy heavier than a normal monster but distinct from a boss; Banshee's shriek bars both bosses and mini bosses from using their abilities for 2 seconds.

entries.name: Mirror Decks
entries.def: A PvP variant where both players use the same pre-assembled deck, so the match is decided by play rather than collection.

entries.name: Multifaction
entries.def: A temporary status on a newly released unit that gives it every faction blessing at once, plus entry to every faction quest and leaderboard. Lasts about a month.

entries.name: Novelty bonus
entries.def: A temporary 10% damage bonus carried by a newly released unit. It runs on its own clock, roughly two months, separate from Multifaction.

entries.name: Pantheon
entries.def: The five damage units, one per faction, that currently hold a seat and a damage bonus. A new damage unit of a faction displaces the previous holder.

entries.name: Phantom
entries.def: A PvP-only mechanic, absent from co-op. It appears on your board at the end of each round; the damage your units deal to it is converted into the health of the boss your opponent must kill. The conversion is negligible in the first waves and grows from wave 3 onwards.

entries.name: Profile perk
entries.def: A permanent bonus to a unit stat on the field, or to your results in a game mode. Perks unlock as your collection's critical damage grows, and are developed with perk fragments and gold.

entries.name: Rank
entries.def: A unit's level on the board, raised by merging. Distinct from card level, which is permanent and raised outside a match.

entries.name: Rarity
entries.def: Common, Rare, Epic or Legendary. It controls which chests a card appears in, how often the shop offers it and what it costs to upgrade — so it governs how quickly a card climbs, not whether it is worth climbing.

entries.name: Reincarnation
entries.def: An enhancement unlocked once a unit reaches level 15 and the 4th Ascension, giving 3 further levels. Each raises bonus deck damage for every unit in the deck, and the bonus stacks across Reincarnated units.

entries.name: Relic
entries.def: An artifact of which only one copy can exist in a single deck.

entries.name: Rune Key
entries.def: Spent on purchases in the seasonal offer store. Where it comes from is not recorded in the in-game text.

entries.name: Rush for Glory
entries.def: A PvP variant where you build a deck and pick a hero by repeatedly choosing from three random options.

entries.name: Season
entries.def: The ranking cycle trophies reset on. They are numbered — Season 73 ended in August 2026 — and each brings its own pass, quests and leaderboards.

entries.name: Spell
entries.def: An ability you equip to a deck and use in battle, unlocked by gaining Legendarity. You take exactly one into a battle.

entries.name: Synergized unit
entries.def: One of a set of summoned units, each of which unlocks a particular synergetic ability on a Reincarnated key unit. If both units are Reincarnated, a further ability unlocks.

entries.name: Talent
entries.def: An unlockable upgrade for a card, tied to your Legendarity progression, that you level to stay competitive.

entries.name: Treasure Map
entries.def: Used before a co-op run to earn more gold from it. There are two types.

entries.name: Trophies
entries.def: Your PvP rating — it decides your arena and therefore what you face, and is not spent on anything.

entries.name: Venom
entries.def: A damage type — the type Banshee inflicts. Distinct from the generic idea of poison, so read a unit's text for which one it actually does.

entries.name: Wave
entries.def: One batch of enemies. What spawns in each wave is not documented here yet; in PvP the Phantom appears at the end of every one.
